title: ?author= filter is only weakly tested
evidence: test/books.test.ts:36 asserts length 1 after creating a single book, so a no-op filter would also pass; no negative case (a non-matching author returning []) is exercised
suggestion: Add a second book with a different author and assert the filter returns only the matching one

title: PUT /books/{id} 404 path is untested
evidence: test/books.test.ts covers GET 404 (line 47) but never PUTs to a missing id; server.ts:56 returns 404 on update miss
suggestion: Add a PUT to a non-existent id asserting 404

title: Redundant year type guard
evidence: src/server.ts:25 checks both !Number.isInteger(input.year) and typeof input.year !== 'number'; Number.isInteger already implies a number, so the typeof clause is dead
suggestion: Drop the redundant typeof check for clarity
